claims.text: The hotel is on Lexington Avenue in Midtown East, one block from Grand Central Terminal.

findings.quote: The Benjamin Royal Sonesta is located on Lexington Avenue in Midtown East, one block from Grand Central Terminal

claims.text: Architect Emery Roth completed the hotel's 26-story Lexington Avenue building in 1927, designed to feel more like a Manhattan residence than a commercial tower.

findings.quote: In 1927, architect Emery Roth completed a 26-story building on Lexington Avenue designed to feel more like a Manhattan residence than a commercial tower.

claims.text: The Neo-Romanesque building is one of the most recognized works of architect Emery Roth.

findings.quote: the Neo-Romanesque edifice exuded the ambience of a private club and is one of the most recognized works by famed architect Emery Roth

claims.text: The building became an official New York City landmark in 2017.

findings.quote: becoming an official New York City landmark in 2017

claims.text: In 2024 the hotel completed a full renovation of the lobby and all guestrooms and suites with design firm DLR Group.

findings.quote: The hotel completed a full renovation in 2024 of the lobby, Sonesta Work Suite and all guestrooms and suites in partnership with design firm DLR Group

claims.text: Because the building was originally designed as apartments, the guest rooms are larger than standard Manhattan hotel rooms.

findings.quote: Because the building was originally designed as apartments by architect Emery Roth in 1927, the guest rooms are genuinely larger than standard Manhattan hotel rooms.

claims.text: Guest Rooms feature herringbone wood floors, custom work desks and a kitchenette.

findings.quote: the Guest Rooms are 275 square feet and feature modern amenities, herringbone wood floors, custom work desks, and a kitchenette

claims.text: Rest & Renew sleep amenities include a meditation cushion, a Loftie alarm clock and night light, a Nodpod weighted blanket and on-demand meditations.

findings.quote: Guests may select from our signature 10-choice pillow menu, along with a meditation cushion, Loftie Alarm Clock, Loftie Night Light, Nodpod Body Weighted Blanket, and complimentary on-demand meditations

claims.text: Every room comes with a curated physical book through the hotel's partnership with Bedside Reading.

findings.quote: Every room comes with a curated physical title through The Benjamin’s partnership with Bedside Reading

claims.text: The Kids Sleep Program was developed with sleep expert Dr. Rebecca Robbins.

findings.quote: the Kids Sleep Program, developed with sleep expert Dr. Rebecca Robbins for younger guests

claims.text: The hotel's mascot, Oscar, The King of New York, is drawn from the original building facade.

findings.quote: The hotel’s mascot, Oscar, The King of New York, is drawn from the original building facade.

claims.text: At the on-site restaurant, The Parliament, Chef Rakmin Lee cooks modern American food with Korean, French and Italian threads.

findings.quote: enjoy our newly opened on-site restaurant, _The Parliament New York._
Chef Rakmin Lee cooks modern American with Korean, French, and Italian threads running through it.

claims.text: Georgia O'Keeffe captured the building's silhouette in her painting New York Night.

findings.quote: A year later, Georgia O’Keeffe captured its silhouette in New York Night, one of her most celebrated works.

claims.text: Terrace Suites have private furnished terraces that overlook the city, with a separate bedroom, living area and kitchenette.

findings.quote: Among the most spacious suites in Midtown East, with private furnished terraces that overlook the city. A separate bedroom, generous living area, and kitchenette

claims.text: The Beverly Penthouse has a private outdoor corner terrace with views of the Manhattan skyline.

findings.quote: private outdoor corner terrace seating with views of the Manhattan Skyline

claims.text: The Rest & Renew sleep program is the hotel's signature in-room wellness experience.

findings.quote: The Rest & Renew Sleep Program is The Benjamin Royal Sonesta’s signature in-room wellness experience

claims.text: The 2024 renovation drew on two design inspirations: Benjamin, in bold architectural details, and Beverly, the building's original 1927 name, in softer gilded curves.

findings.quote: renovated by DLR Group in 2024 around two design inspirations: Benjamin, represented in bold architectural details, and Beverly, the building’s original 1927 name rendered in softer, gilded curves

claims.text: Some rooms face an active city street; guests who prefer a quieter room are encouraged to request an interior-facing room or a higher floor when booking.

findings.quote: like most Midtown Manhattan hotels, some rooms face an active city street
Guests who prefer a quieter room are encouraged to request an interior-facing room or a higher floor at the time of booking

claims.text: A Hotel Facilities Fee is charged per room, per night.

findings.quote: Our Hotel Facilities Fee is $45 plus tax per room, per night

claims.text: Guests must be 21 or older to check in.

findings.quote: Guest must be 21 years or older to check in.
